questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: In Langmuir's model of adsorption of a gas on a solid surface,
options: the rate of dissociation of adsorbed molecules from the surface does not depend on the surface covered
the adsorption at a single site on the surface may involve multiple molecules at the same time
the mass of gas striking a given area of surface is proportional to the pressure of the gas
the mass of gas striking a given area of surface is independent of the pressure of the gas
questions.solution: $According to Langmuir's adsorption isotherm, the mass of gas striking a given area of surface is proportional to the pressure of the gas as \frac{x}{m}=\frac{k^{\prime} p}{1+k p}$

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which one of the following is a case of negative adsorption?
options: Acetic acid solution in contact with animal charcoal.
Dilute $\mathrm{KCl}$ solution in contact with blood charcoal.
Concentration $\mathrm{KCl}$ solution in contact with blood charcoal.
$\mathrm{H}_{2}$ gas in contact with charcoal at $300 \mathrm{ K}$.
questions.solution: When the concentration of the adsorbate is less on the surface as compare to its concentration in the bulk is called negative adsorption. Add from left in this adsorption, concentration of dilute $\mathrm{KCl}$ solution is less on the surface of blood charcoal as compare to its concentration in solution.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which one of the following is the most effective in causing the coagulation of an $\mathrm{As}_{2} \mathrm{ S}_{3}$ sol?
questions.solution: $According to Hardy Schulze rule, greater the valency of the coagulating ion, greater is its coagulating power. Thus, out of the given, \mathrm{AlCl}_{3} \left(\mathrm{Al}^{3+}\right)is most effective for causing coagulation of \mathrm{As}_{2} \mathrm{ S}_{3},sol.$

questions.solution: In a colloidal system, the substance present in large amount in the mixture is called the dispersed medium \& the solute is called dispersed phase. In case of milk and water solution the dispersed phase is milk protein $\ $ fat and water is dispersed medium.
